title: Four shapes of work, counted
caption: Steps performed for a list of n things, counting a halving-per-item for the sort-shaped row. At n = 10 every row is instant and the shape is invisible. At n = 200,000 the last row is 40 billion steps — about four thousand seconds at ten million steps a second — while the row above it finishes in a third of a second. The shape is what you are choosing when you choose a method.
